summary: Regression + feature testing for MediTrans Ontario Admin (creator RBAC + user/change management). Backend: 23/23 admin pytest tests pass. Frontend: full admin UI verified end-to-end (login auto-promote, RBAC redirect for driver, stats, Users CRUD with persistence, Plans edit + reflect in public /api/subscriptions/plans, Fees edit + persist + reflect in /api/fees/agreement, Transactions, Jobs admin CRUD). Leftover TEST_ jobs and plan/fee mutations cleaned up; defaults restored to spec (basic=$49, pro=$99, premium=$149; base_rate_per_km=1.5).

issues: React a11y warning: Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent (non-blocking; add <DialogDescription/> to each DialogContent)

passed_tests: GET /api/admin/stats returns total_users, active_subscriptions, total_jobs, total_revenue
PUT /api/admin/users/{id} updates role/subscription_plan/subscription_status and persists via GET
PUT /api/admin/plans/{id} persists and reflects in public /api/subscriptions/plans
PUT /api/admin/fees updates and reflects in public /api/fees/agreement
Frontend: driver sees no Admin link/badge; /admin redirects to /dashboard
Frontend: admin sees nav-admin-link and dashboard-admin-badge on /dashboard
Frontend /admin: stats cards render (Total Users=7, Active Subs=1, Total Jobs=2, Revenue=$0.00)
Frontend /admin Users: Edit dialog updates full_name (persists after reload)
Frontend /admin Plans: edit pro price to 111.11 persists after reload (reverted to 99)
Frontend /admin Fees: edit base_rate_per_km 1.5->1.75 persists after reload (reverted to 1.5)
action_items: Optional (non-blocking): Add <DialogDescription> to each DialogContent in AdminDashboardPage.js to silence Radix a11y warning and improve screen-reader UX.
Optional: AdminDashboardPage stats header shows 'Revenue (paid)' but card layout on narrow screens not tested here; verify responsive layout <768px if needed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py AdminUserUpdate: None values are stripped before $set; therefore clearing subscription_plan/status via admin is not possible without a sentinel (e.g., empty string). Minor UX limitation.
server.py startup_event is sync-safe but uses deprecated FastAPI on_event; consider switching to lifespan handlers in a future refactor.

server.py get_current_user returns the raw DB user dict including password_hash to downstream handlers; most endpoints are safe, but prefer sanitizing at the dependency level to avoid accidental leaks in future routes.
AdminDashboardPage.js has grown large (>650 lines) and mixes multiple tab components; consider splitting into UsersTab/JobsTab/PlansTab/FeesTab/TransactionsTab for maintainability.
Fee price input uses step=0.01 but no min/max validation; consider client-side bounds, particularly platform_commission which must be 0..1.
